resources.string: Move a coloured square on the HUD and log where its edges disappear.

While parked, start the square and move it towards each edge. Save Fully visible just before an edge disappears, then save the cut-off side. Repeat at different heights. L/R mark image edges, not vehicle sides. Stops when you leave or after 3 minutes without input.
Square stopped. Camera framing and saved HUD settings stay unchanged.
What do you see on the windscreen?
The latest 128 observations survive closing the app and are included in Diagnostics exports. Android cannot see optical clipping or factory graphics. The test does not apply new camera bounds.
